msg: Hi, I'm Advanced Open Water certified, from London. I'm staying at a hotel on Isla Grande for 5 days. I'd like the 4-dive package over 2 days. How much and how do I book?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That’s a great plan—the Rosario Islands are a lovely place for certified dives. Since you’ll already be staying on Isla Grande, the 4-dive package is the island-based option. The online price is listed below; the regular price is also included. The price is the same in USD and COP, with the currency depending on whether you’re Colombian or a resident of Colombia.

You can book online here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)
• Fun Dives - 1 dive (1 day): 97 USD · 108 USD (345.000 COP · 383.000 COP)
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)

This link is for Fun Dives, not the 4-dive package. I don’t have the correct booking link for the 4-dive package handy.

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to help you book?
